database_safety_strategy: Copilot tools use predefined repository methods through a read-only repository mode that sets PostgreSQL transactions to READ ONLY.
dynamic_tool_selection: A deterministic Python router exposes only the safe read-only tools relevant to each request; semantic and mutation requests expose no database tools.
final_synthesis_policy: After tool evidence is collected, final answer synthesis runs without tools to prevent repeated tool-call loops.
history_policy: Client-provided history is bounded to six recent user/assistant messages by default and only user/assistant roles are accepted.
keep_alive_policy: Ollama requests send the configured keep_alive value, defaulting to 10m.
knowledge_retrieval_strategy: Deterministic lexical token overlap with stable tie-breaking and no external embeddings; the default top-k is 2.
no_progress_protection: Repeated identical tool calls are memoized within one request and final synthesis runs with tools disabled after evidence is collected.
response_limitations: Responses are grounded in structured evidence and trusted knowledge, but natural-language output can still make mistakes.
synthetic_data_statement: Platform data is fictional and synthetic for a local portfolio project.
tool_call_memoization: Tool calls are cached within one copilot request by tool name plus canonical validated arguments.
